requirements.text: 7+ years in SRE, production operations, or reliability-focused infrastructure engineering, with hands on responsibility for distributed services.
Strong troubleshooting across Linux, Kubernetes, networking, storage dependencies, and distributed systems under production pressure.
Experience defining SLIs and SLOs, building alerting and response workflows, and using service evidence to prioritize engineering work.
Strong scripting and automation skills, including tested remediation tooling, configuration management, and integration with delivery pipelines.
Experience with incident management, root cause analysis, post-incident follow-through, and clear stakeholder communication.
Ability to balance urgent service restoration with longer-term reliability improvements and to document actionable operational procedures.
Experience operating AI platforms, ML infrastructure, GPU-backed inference, distributed training, or large HPC-like service environments.
Familiarity with Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/OpenSearch, Loki, PagerDuty, DCGM, and GPU failure diagnostics.
Experience with error budgets, safe deployment strategies, disaster recovery, and capacity planning across mixed batch and online services.
Preferred: -Certified Professional AI Operations (NCP-AIO) and Certified Kubernetes
Administrator (CKA). Observability specialization: Prometheus Certified Associate (PCA). Foundational:
